main_text.head: LYCAONIA REGIO ASIÆ Minoris supra Pisidiam.
main_text.p: Dionysius.HArum autem ad Orientem mediam terram habitant. Periti in bellis Lycaones, curuis arcubus vtentes.
main_text.head: Lystra vrbs Lycaoniæ.

p.i: Inde Lycaonios incedens passibus agros Lystram Paulus adit.

main_text.head: Lycus fluuius Lycaoniæ.

p.i: Hic fontes natura nouos emisit, & illic Clausit, & antiquis tam multa tremoribus orbis Flumina prosiliunt, aut exsiccata residunt. Sic vbi terreno Lycus est epotus hiatu, Exiit procul hinc, alioque renascitur ore. Spectabat diuersa locis, Phasimq; Lycumq;.

page.notes: The faint lines below the main text and the blurred printing on the lower half are show-through from the reverse page and are not transcribed. The last line of the verse is partly unclear at its end. The margin note at the lower right is partly unreadable. Marginal note "Virg. Georg." is printed in italic with a cut-off word.
